arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Srinivasan argued the district court found systemic violations of the Equal Educational Opportunities Act.
Mr. Starr stated the district court found the Nogales school system failed to provide equal opportunity.
Ms. Saharsky noted the sides that brought the case asked for complete dissolution of the court's immediate orders.
Ms. Saharsky argued the district court did not place remedial orders in the 2000 judgment.
